[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover PerspectiveCamera orientation/projection and CPU frustum culling through nested, hidden and skinned scenes

impact_assessment.why: The shooter renders through Keystone's camera and culling, but the suite has no direct consumer tests for orientation clamping, projection bounds, nested world bounds or conservative skinned visibility.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five deterministic GPU-free tests pin look_at/rotate/move math, NDC near/far and aspect behavior, plane/AABB contract, nested culling and hidden/skinned scene rules.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no game/sim/hash change; temp scenes only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure CPU math with temp scenes, full suite, determinism and project gates.
